console.notes: Console availability and pinout vary by model; several models need serial adapters = UNKNOWN.

ethernet_defaults.notes: Adoption-state devices use DHCP; standalone fallback IP varies by device class. UNKNOWN until lab evidence.

controller_adopt.notes: PRIMARY day-0 path: local UniFi Network application (controller) adopts devices over L2/L3 (inform URL). Controller runs on the engineer's PC/site server — offline-capable per §19.

pnp_dhcp.notes: DHCP discovery of controller via inform URL/DNS.

rollback_mechanism.notes: Rollback = re-adoption to previous configuration revision via controller API (§14). Device-local config rollback capability = NOT_SUPPORTED (controller-managed model).

bootstrap.note: Seed templates pending lab evidence (register OI-0171). Each step is individually verified before the next executes; failure halts the sequence with a typed reason — never blind continuation.
